description: Connect TableWealth to review your net worth, accounts, holdings, transactions, and cash flow in ChatGPT. Explore spending categories, bounded portfolio summaries, saved net-worth snapshots, and data freshness. Financial access is read-only and limited to the workspace, accounts, and permissions you authorize. TableWealth cannot move money, place trades, or edit financial records. You can either automatically connect accounts or manually upload account information.

defaultPrompt: Show my largest investment holdings and portfolio allocation.
